_doc: Shared transfer policy. Both Windows and Mac read this before send/receive. Modifications take effect immediately.
_network_mode_doc: closed = trusted private LAN (10GbE direct link); secrets flow freely. open = exposed network; RAW_SECRET rules apply.

secrets._doc: Patterns here are blocked regardless of network_mode (because they leak even on closed nets — signing keys, certs, mobile provisioning).

language_detection._doc: When sending a folder, scan up to depth 2 for any marker. Detected languages contribute their preset ignore rules.

line_endings._doc: Bytes preserved on transfer (else SHA-256 invalid). Manifest gets per-file `line_endings: lf|crlf|mixed|binary` so receiver can normalize.

clipboard._doc: Clipboard images stored as PNG under 70_Clipboard/images/, sha256-deduped, downscaled to max_dimension. Files older than retention_days are deleted (JSONL entry remains as a tombstone). Total dir size capped at total_cap_mb; oldest evicted first.

filename_compat._doc: Block forbidden chars on Windows side (< > : " / \ | ? *), normalize Korean to NFC (Mac default NFD → Windows NFC). Warn if two files differ only in case.
